name: Jalousie
description: Jalousie slats: angled louvres with daylight between every pair.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; rect*6 { x: -30; y: calc(@n(-1) * 16.6 + 2); width: 160; height: 10; transform: rotate(-12 50 50); fill: #000 }); mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; rect*6 { x: -30; y: calc(@n(-1) * 16.6 + 2); width: 160; height: 10; transform: rotate(-12 50 50); fill: #000 }); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
